compute_similarity_matrix: compute similarity matrix between input and query embeddings for PACO object-part-attribute queries
obj_with_attributes: compute object similarity scores with attribute product aggregation for PACO queries
parts_with_attributes: compute part similarity scores with per-part attribute aggregation and averaging for PACO queries
product_attr: compute geometric mean of queried attributes with fallback for zero-attribute queries
assert_valid_inputs: validate that input and query embeddings are 2D tensors with matching feature dimensions
